{{Quote|The encampment in the Coronet Arms Hotel has become a symbol of the uprising. Losing the hotel would gut this pathetic rebellion.|Malichose|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Coronet Arms Hotel''' was a hotel in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the rebellion and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] turned it into an artillery firebase in order to repel the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The defenders fought back numerous assaults from the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], boosting the resistance's morale and leading to celebrations in the hotel.

To break their spirits, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Malichose]] tasked an Imperial official with eliminating the defenders at the hotel and destroying their artillery.
